narrative.details:
I would ask you to help me create a toxin of sorts, to pacify a great creature living here in the crater.  It is not deadly, and only the keen eyes of a champion can hope to collect the ingredients.

You can find the bloodcap mushrooms growing within the bloodpetal sprouts all across the crater.  Gorishi stings are from the insects inside and around the Slithering Scar, located in the southern part of the crater.
narrative.objectives: Collect 8 Bloodcap and 8 Gorishi Stings, and return to Torwa Pathfinder in Un'Goro Crater.
narrative.offerRewardText:
The ingredients at last!

With the Un'Goro soil I have collected, the toxin is easily concocted...
